description: Source code for the Intel ACE per-core watchdog driver in Zephyr RTOS, managing watchdog timers, interrupts, and hardware control for the ACE platform.

methods.name: intel_adsp_wdt_setup
methods.description: Configures watchdog timers for each CPU core, sets response mode, and resets watchdogs.

methods.name: intel_adsp_wdt_install_timeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout period for the watchdog and configures reset behavior.

methods.name: intel_adsp_wdt_feed
methods.description: Restarts the watchdog counter for a specific CPU core.

methods.name: intel_adsp_wdt_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling watchdog interrupts, calling callback if registered.

methods.name: intel_adsp_wdt_init
methods.description: Initializes watchdog hardware, sets up device, and enables interrupts.

methods.name: intel_adsp_watchdog_pause
methods.description: Pauses the watchdog timer for a specific core.

methods.name: intel_adsp_watchdog_resume
methods.description: Resumes the watchdog timer for a specific core.
